note: Read 2026-10-13 from hornady.com only (robots.txt allows /bullets and /ammunition). Line pages: ELD Match, ELD-X, ELD-VT, A-Tip Match, A-MAX, CX, ECX, MonoFlex, NTX, V-MAX, SST, InterLock, FTX, Sub-X, DGS, DGX Bonded, Match, AeroMatch, XTP, Varmint; product pages for records without a line word in the name. Empty on purpose: A-Tip tip (aluminium tip, no enum value); A-MAX tip/construction (page says only 'sharp pointed tip'); V-MAX base (line has both boattail and flat base); Varmint line tip/base ('Primarily' spire point / flat base, not per product); InterLock/FTX/CX/ECX/MonoFlex/Sub-X/XTP/NTX/ELD-VT base not stated; XTP construction not stated (lead not named); FMJ base/nose not stated; Traditional & FMJ (.224 55 HP, .257 60 FP, .308 125 HP) not stated. Flex Tip (FTX/MonoFlex/Sub-X) and Heat Shield (ELD) mapped to polymer_tip; DGS 'Solid' with copper-clad steel jacket over lead core mapped to fmj. Factory cartridge pages mostly give no bullet details; line-page facts applied via the bullet line named in the cartridge name; component_bullet from the cartridge name. Not readable: /bullets/rifle/30-cal-308-110-gr-sp (JavaScript wall twice); ammunition line page precision-hunter (fetch error). .51 750 gr A-MAX URL now shows the A-Tip Match 750 gr page; only A-MAX line base used.
